A separate Regional flight streams verified-shape frames, rejects a staged frame and mission, lands, takes off, replays across frame/hash boundaries and recovers after worker termination. Three warmed repetitions of three-axis 100 deg/s step responses at 250/500/1000 Hz against coupled 2000 Hz reference.
